question: Which of the following conjunctions is NOT used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **While** is used in the first paragraph of the passage.

 
 
• Example: *"While advancements in medical technology have made surgeries safer and more accessible..."*
 
 
 
• **Apart from** is used in the second paragraph.
 
 
• Example: *"Apart from physical risks, plastic surgery can also have psychological consequences."*
 
 
 
• **And** appears several times in the passage to connect words and ideas.
 
 
• Example: *"infections, scarring, and even organ damage"*
 
 
 
• **Because** does **not appear anywhere** in the passage.

Therefore, the conjunction that is **NOT used in the passage is "Because".**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **While** – A subordinating conjunction used to introduce a contrasting idea.
 
• **Apart from** – A phrase used to add additional information besides something already mentioned.
 
• **And** – A coordinating conjunction used to connect words, phrases, or clauses.
 
• **Because** – A subordinating conjunction used to show cause or reason, but it is not used in the given passage.
